# Jonathan Wallace — Georgian Bay Real Estate

> Jonathan Wallace is a REALTOR and Salesperson serving Southern Georgian Bay, Ontario: Midland, Penetanguishene, Tiny Township, Tay Township, and Wasaga Beach. He offers full-service home selling built on a personal risk-free listing guarantee, premium marketing (professional staging, photography, cinematic video, 3D tours, floor plans, custom feature books), and a private network of qualified buyers who preview homes before MLS. Waterfront and estate property is the deliberate focus of his practice, with particular depth in Tiny Township, where he lives and works the shoreline. Buyers get local representation and early access to coming-soon listings. One point of contact from first call to closing. Phone: 705-433-2525.

## Tiny Township focus

Tiny Township is the primary specialization. It is not a single market: values move by pocket, not by township average. Jonathan Wallace works the Georgian Bay shore (Thunder Beach, Cedar Point, the Champlain Road corridor), Farlain Lake as an inland lake with a different buyer than the big-lake shore, the southern beaches (Balm Beach, Woodland Beach, Deanlea Beach, Wymbolwood Beach, Bluewater Beach), the inland villages (Lafontaine, Perkinsfield, Wyevale), and vacant land across the township.

Selling in Tiny turns on details that do not apply in town: the shore road allowance and whether it has been purchased, leased or left open; private well and septic, since the entire township is on septic and only Lafontaine, Perkinsfield and Wyevale have municipal water; genuine four-season construction and winter road maintenance; beach access rights on the southern shore; and, for land, whether the parcel is a legal building lot that can support an approved septic system.
